summary: verdaccio-okta-oauth ships preinstall dropper: downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall="node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads a Bun binary from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases into a temp directory, chmod +x's it, and invokes it against the sibling file math_init.js with cwd set to the package directory. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line obfuscated bundle (string-array rotation via a helper function shuffling a large mixed-value array, mangled identifiers, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header) whose behavior is only executable by the freshly downloaded Bun runtime and is not analyzable by Node-based tooling. The declared package purpose is a Verdaccio Okta OAuth plugin; downloading an alternate language runtime at preinstall to execute an unrelated obfuscated blob has no relationship to OAuth authentication. The package.json repository points to github.com/servicetitan/uikit.git, but the shipped preinstall dropper is inconsistent with a first-party ServiceTitan auth plugin, consistent with a masquerade of a legitimate-sounding internal package name.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
